events.title: SnorQ v0.1.1 demo AVAILABLE NOW!
events.summary: Hi everyone! Demo version 0.1.1 is now live! This update focuses on balancing and bug fixes. Patch Notes 0.1.1 – DemoContent: Added a music track for defeated bosses Added missing sounds for some enemies and companions Improved font readability Added a notification for the Items menu Updated the item list Improved the stamina bar Gameplay Balancing: Rebalanced some enemies and bosses Rebalanced companions Adjusted difficulty in some levels Bug Fixes: Fixed bugs and menu layering issues on PC Fix
